favorites.title: Favorite Albums
favorites.emptyLocal: No favorite albums in Local Storage.
favorites.emptyPlex: No favorite albums on Plex Server.
favorites.emptyHint: Click the heart icon on album cards to add them here.
favorites.missingDiskAlert: Album folder not found on disk. Check if the external drive is plugged in.

plex.disconnectedDesc: Connect your Plex account to synchronize and play your audio libraries, albums, and Hi-Res tracks with bit-perfect fidelity.

settings.title: System Preferences
settings.dopDesc: Encapsulates native DSD streams into PCM frames for direct playback on compatible DACs without conversion.
settings.pipewireNotice: PipeWire dynamically manages sample rate switching and routes audio to your default system output without exclusive device locking.

wizard.subtitle: Initial Setup Wizard
wizard.step1Desc: To ensure bit-perfect native playback, select your dedicated USB DAC. Direct devices operate without system resampling.
wizard.step1Exclusive: Exclusive mode guarantees the digital stream is sent bit-by-bit directly to hardware up to DSD128 and PCM 192/384 kHz.
wizard.step2Title: Where does your music come from?
wizard.step2Desc: You can use local files only, your Plex server, or both simultaneously.
wizard.step2LocalDesc: Music stored on SSDs, internal hard drives, USB flash drives, or NFS/SMB network shares.
wizard.step2PlexDesc: High-fidelity streaming from your Plex Media Server libraries.
wizard.step3LocalDesc: Add one or more folders for unified indexing.
wizard.step4PlexDesc: Authenticate with your official Plex account to automatically import your servers.
wizard.stepFinalDesc: Sonante will initialize the audio engine in the background and perform a differential scan of your tracks.

about.title: About Sonante
about.audioEngineDesc: Exclusive bit-perfect output with native DSD (DoP) and PCM up to 384 kHz / 32-bit directly to hardware.
about.localDesc: Unified multi-folder indexing, instant folder browsing, and automatic deduplication.
about.plexDesc: Native PIN/OAuth integration with local LAN discovery and FLAC/DSD direct streaming.
about.devDesc: Built in Rust, Tauri, React, and MPD.
